LESSON: MIRACLE OF HEALING

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: The Life of Jesus Christ
Topic 3.4: Miracle of Healing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Miracle of Healing. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How did the bleeding woman portray faith in God?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe the miracle of healing the bleeding woman
2. identify different ways the church and government help the sick in society

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. describe the miracle of healing the bleeding woman
   In simple words: practise until you can describe the miracle of healing the bleeding woman. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. identify different ways the church and government help the sick in society
   In simple words: practise until you can identify different ways the church and government help the sick in society. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Miracle of Healing using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Miracle of Healing in the examples.
2. Explain Miracle of Healing to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Miracle of Healing.
4. Show that you can: describe the miracle of healing the bleeding woman

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Miracle of Healing using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Miracle of Healing important for a Grade 6 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. In turns, read Luke 8:43-48 and retell the miracle,
2. Discuss different ways the church and government are helping the sick and share in class,
3. Discuss lessons learnt from the healing of the bleeding woman,
4. Communication and collaboration: the skill of speaking clearly and effectively is enhanced as learners discuss ways the church and government are helping the sick in the society.
5. Integrity: learners display honesty as learnt from the healing of the bleeding woman.

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. describe the miracle of healing the bleeding woman
2. identify different ways the church and government help the sick in society

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
